title: The Altar of Incense and Atonement Money

questions.question: What was the altar of incense made of?
options: Acacia wood overlaid with pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: Acacia wood overlaid with pure gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:1,3 (ESV): "You shall make an altar on which to burn incense; you shall make it of acacia wood... You shall overlay it with pure gold."

questions.question: Where was the altar of incense placed?
options: Before the veil, in front of the mercy seat
questions.correctAnswer: Before the veil, in front of the mercy seat
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:6 (ESV): "You shall put it in front of the veil that is above the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy seat."

questions.question: How often was Aaron to burn incense on the altar?
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:7-8 (ESV): "Aaron shall burn fragrant incense on it. Every morning... and at twilight."

questions.question: What was every Israelite required to pay when counted?
options: A half shekel as a ransom for his life
questions.correctAnswer: A half shekel as a ransom for his life
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:12-13 (ESV): "Each one who is numbered shall give... a half shekel as an offering to the Lord."

questions.question: What was the bronze basin (laver) used for?
options: Washing hands and feet of the priests
questions.correctAnswer: Washing hands and feet of the priests
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:19 (ESV): "Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it."

questions.question: What would happen if the priests did not wash at the basin?
options: They would be unclean for a day
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:20-21 (ESV): "They shall wash with water, so that they may not die."

questions.question: Was the ransom payment the same for rich and poor?
options: Yes, all paid a half shekel
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, all paid a half shekel
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:15 (ESV): "The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel."

questions.question: What ingredients were in the holy anointing oil?
options: Myrrh, cinnamon, calamus, cassia, and olive oil
questions.correctAnswer: Myrrh, cinnamon, calamus, cassia, and olive oil
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:23-24 (ESV): "Liquid myrrh... sweet-smelling cinnamon... aromatic cane (calamus)... cassia... olive oil."

questions.question: What was forbidden regarding the anointing oil?
options: Pouring it on an ordinary person or making any like it
questions.correctAnswer: Pouring it on an ordinary person or making any like it
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:32-33 (ESV): "It shall not be poured on the body of an ordinary person, and you shall make no other like it."

questions.question: What type of incense was forbidden on the golden altar?
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:9 (ESV): "You shall not offer unauthorized incense on it."

questions.question: How often was atonement made on the horns of the incense altar?
options: Once a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonement
questions.correctAnswer: Once a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonement
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:10 (ESV): "Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once a year."

questions.question: What was the penalty for making the holy incense for personal use?
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:38 (ESV): "Whoever makes any like it to use as perfume shall be cut off from his people."

questions.question: What were the four ingredients of the sacred incense?
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:34 (ESV): "Take sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, sweet spices with pure frankincense."

questions.question: Where was the bronze basin placed?
options: Between the tent of meeting and the altar
questions.correctAnswer: Between the tent of meeting and the altar
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:18 (ESV): "You shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar."

questions.question: What would happen to someone who made anointing oil like the holy formula?
questions.explanation: Exodus 30:33 (ESV): "Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people."

key_verse_text: You shall put it in front of the veil that is above the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy seat that is above the testimony, where I will meet with you.
